name: Share India Securities Limited
summary: Share India Securities Limited operates as a financial services company in India. It operates through the Share Broking/Trading Business, Insurance Business, Merchant Banking Business, NBFC Business, Technology Services, and Wealth management business segments. The company offers retail and institutional broking, research and advisory, financial product distribution, wealth management, and depository services; distribution service of life insurance and general insurance products to individual and groups; IPO related services, such as advisory, valuation, and lead manager services; vehicle, micro-finance, and SME loans; software development and IT support services; and algo trading solutions.…
